long_term_memory.evidence_quote: stored in a persistent cacheD asset. Caching enables reuse across sections
long_term_memory.note: Icon asset cache directory persists across runs (assets/icons); closest value file_notes.

state_persistence.note: Intermediate artifacts (outline.json, storyboard_with_assets.json) are reloaded if present, so an interrupted run resumes from that stage.

self_verification.evidence_quote: the Criticuses visual anchor prompts to iteratively adjust spatial layout and clarity
self_verification.note: Critic is a separate VLM (Gemini-2.5 Pro) judging rendered video; compile errors drive repair but are rendering, not tests.

rollback.note: No undo/revert/snapshot mechanism in the config or agent; failed code is regenerated rather than rolled back.

termination_condition.note: Pipeline also ends naturally when all sections render; retry caps bound the loops.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: stored in a persistent cacheD asset. Caching enables reuse across sections, preventing redundant generation
cost_controls.note: max_tokens caps per call; asset cache (not prompt cache).

timeouts.note: No timeout fields in RunConfig; subprocess rendering timeouts not visible in the shown evidence.

execution_isolation.note: Manim code is rendered locally via subprocess; no container configuration shipped.

filesystem_access.note: Generated Python is executed on the host with the user's privileges; writes are directed to CASES/ output dirs.

network_policy.evidence_quote: To enrich videos with icons, set `ICONFINDER_API_KEY` from [IconFinder]
network_policy.note: No network restriction mechanism; outbound API calls to LLM providers and IconFinder.

permission_model.note: Generated code is executed directly with no allowlist or confirmation step.

tracing.note: Per-run JSON artifacts (outline.json, storyboard.json, code, token usage) written to the case folder; console prints otherwise.

replayability.evidence_quote: interpretable, as every sequence, layout, and rendering decision is explicitly scripted and thus auditable
replayability.note: Saved code/storyboard can be re-rendered, but model calls are not replayed; no replay module.

eval_hooks.note: eval_TQ.py and eval_AES.py ship in src/.

guardrails.note: No filtering/blocking layer in the agent; a 'safe' topics list exists as curated input data only.
